name: Ahmed
description: Ahmed Ghappour is General Counsel at Flashbots and a former computer engineer and law professor. His work bridges law and computer science, focusing on surveillance, anonymity, and the legal and technical foundations of privacy-preserving systems. He works with engineers and researchers on confidential computing and decentralized infrastructure. Previously, he served as General Counsel at Nym Technologies and Espresso Systems and taught cybersecurity and privacy law at Boston University. Earlier in his career, he worked as an international human rights attorney and a federal criminal defense lawyer on national security and computer crime cases.
